idea-plugin.name: Smart Request
idea-plugin.description:
A lightweight HTTP client inside IntelliJ IDEA, built for quickly exercising Java and Spring controllers.

  • Organize requests in groups with a project-level request tree, including moving requests between groups from the context menu.
  • Switch between environment profiles such as local, dev, test, and prod.
  • Resolve {{variables}} from the active environment, with highlighting and completion.
  • Support REST path parameters such as /users/{id} from a dedicated Path tab.
  • Edit header and query parameter rows with a single click, in a table whose key and value columns share a readable 3:4 layout.
  • Keep the URL query string and the Params table in sync in both directions.
  • Define per-environment global headers and query parameters that are applied to every request and locked in the request editor.
  • Keep request history and cache the last response for each request during the session.
  • Generate requests from gutter icons on Spring controllers and handler methods.
  • Generate editable JSON request bodies from DTO fields and Swagger field examples.
  • Copy any request as a Linux/macOS or PowerShell cURL command.
  • JSON response syntax highlighting, folding and in-body search.
  • Capture response values into environment variables from the Extract tab (data.token, data.items[0].id, headers.X-Request-Id, status) and reuse them as {{variables}} in later requests.
  • Import Spring controller endpoints with one click.
